crossRefs.note: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt…

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
translations.bsb: “Why is the decree from the king so harsh?” he asked. Then Arioch explained the situation to Daniel.
translations.kjv: He answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
translations.asv: he answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Wherefore is the decree so urgent from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.
